flowRoot.flowPara: Speaker — Symfony Day Tunisia (City of Science, 2013): Presented "Real-time Web with WebSockets in Symfony", demonstrating low-latency bidirectional architecture patterns.
Open-source tooling enthusiast (Neovim, Hyprland, QMK ortholinear mechanical builds), sci-fi & gaming.

text.tspan: Decentralized Finance (Web3) Infrastructure: Architected and deployed production EVM smart contracts (ERC-20, staking,
pool management) using Solidity, Foundry, and OpenZeppelin; built real-time off-chain indexing pipelines and responsive
dApp interfaces using Wagmi, Viem, and Next.js.
Serverless Cloud Architecture & Modernization: Migrated high-traffic legacy monolithic backends to AWS Lambda and Bref
(PHP/Node.js), cutting compute infrastructure costs by ~35% while achieving autoscaling reliability for peak traffic.
Real-time Web Platforms & API Systems: Designed distributed RESTful and WebSocket systems utilizing Mercure, Redis, and
MongoDB/PostgreSQL, optimizing query bottlenecks and reducing average API response latency under concurrent loads.
DevOps & CI/CD Automation: Standardized Docker-based containerized environments and GitHub Actions deployment
pipelines across multi-client repositories, reducing release cycles from days to minutes.
Developed scalable internal architecture tools, automated deployment scripts, and engineered comprehensive unit/
functional test suites using PHP, Symfony, and PHPUnit to improve release stability
Led technical architecture and end-to-end delivery of client web platforms using PHP, Symfony, and MySQL,
mentoring junior developers in clean architecture standards.
Senior Backend & Web3 Engineer with 15+ years of experience architecting
resilient, high-throughput cloud platforms, event-driven microservices, and
EVM smart contract systems. Proven technical lead skilled in full lifecycle
delivery across distributed backend architectures (TypeScript / Node.js, Rust,
PHP/Bref), serverless AWS cloud infrastructure, and low-latency Web3 data
